data.action: 在龙门夜市摊位前品尝香辣鱼丸串
data.description: 【陈 · 龙门夜市】龙门老街的小吃摊升起阵阵热气，红灯笼照着热闹的人群。陈穿着街头便服，拿起一串香辣鱼丸尝了一口，难得地露出满足的笑容——「巡逻了一整晚，先吃点东西吧。这家摊位我很熟，今晚我请客。」
data.promptProse: Ch'en tastes a spicy fishball skewer at the Lungmen night-market stall, a pleased blush accompanying the rare relaxed expression. Open vintage floral shirt, white tee and washed dark jeans retain her street outfit. The medium view includes the food counter before her and clothed shoppers passing between stalls behind. Red lanterns warm her face and skewer, while neon reflects across utensils and the wet walkway, separating the crowd from the darker stall interiors.
data.title: 陈 · 龙门夜市
